in_marathi.name: Vishnupriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lover of Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishnupriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vishnupriya is derived from Sanskrit and Hindu traditions. It is a combination of two words: Vishnu and Priya. Vishnu is the name of the Hindu God of Preservation, while Priya means 'beloved' or 'lover'. Thus, Vishnupriya translates to 'Lover of Vishnu' or 'Beloved of Vishnu'.
